Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
My God, the seekers have stopped at Your door
And the poor have sought refuge in Your presence
And the ship of the destitute has anchored on the shore
Of the sea of Your generosity and nobility

Arabic text: يَرْجُوْنَ الْجَوَازَ إِلَى سَاحَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ وَنِعْمَتِكَ
Translation: Hoping to cross over to the realm of Your mercy and blessings

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ إِنْ كُنْتَ لَا تَرْحَمُ فِيْ هٰذَا الشَّهْرِ الشَّرِيْفِ
Translation: My God, if in this noble month You only show mercy

Arabic text: إِلَّا لِمَنْ اَخْلَصَ لَكَ فِيْ صِيَامِهِ وَقِيَامِهِ
Translation: To those who are sincere to You in their fasting and prayers
Then who is there for the sinful and negligent one

Arabic text: إِذَا غَرِقَ فِيْ بَحْرِ ذُنُوْبِهِ وَ آثَامِهِ
Translation: When he drowns in the sea of his sins and wrongdoings

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ إِنْ كُنْتَ لَا تَرْحَمُ إِلَّا المُطِيْعِيْنَ فَمَنْ لِلْعَاصِيْنَ
Translation: My God, if You only show mercy to the obedient, then who is there for the disobedient

Arabic text: وَإِنْ كُنْتَ لَا تَقْبَلُ إِلَّا مِنَ الْعَامِلِيْنَ، فَمَنْ لِلْمُقَصِّرِيْنَ
Translation: And if You only accept from those who do good deeds, then who is there for the negligent ones
My God, the fasting ones have profited, and the praying ones have succeeded
And the sincere ones have been saved, while we are Your sinful servants

Arabic text: فَارْحَمْنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ وَاَعْتِقْنَا مِنَ النَّارِ بِعَفْوِكَ يَا كَرِيْمُ
Translation: So have mercy on us through Your mercy and free us from the Fire through Your pardon, O Generous One
O Most Merciful of those who show mercy

Arabic text: وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِهِ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ
Translation: And may Allah send blessings upon Muhammad and his pure family
